g.title: cut row 2 between columns 3 and 4: separates the 3.3 V LED node from the 3V3_SYS strip
cut row 4 between columns 2 and 3: separates the 5 V LED node from the 5V_SYS strip
cut row 5 between columns 34 and 35: leaves interface pin 5 unconnected
cut row 6 between columns 24 and 25: leaves interface pin 6 unconnected
cut row 8 between columns 26 and 27: splits MID (Q2/Q3) from the node between R_S and F_EDU
cut row 8 between columns 34 and 35: leaves interface pin 8 unconnected
cut row 14 between columns 5 and 6: splits 12V_IN from 12V_F around fuse F1
L1 (GND): joins the two ground strips
L2 (GND): joins the input ground strip
L3 (12V_SYS): diode cathode to the 12 V system strip
